description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed 
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers
Holding priority, activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Azorius Chancery's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
